import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007L;

    static class HashFunction {
        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        static long getSeed() {
            long seed = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() * (getRandomAddr() | 1));
            return seed;
        }

        static long getRandomAddr() {
            // simulate get_random_addr by creating and deleting an object
            Object p = new Object();
            return System.identityHashCode(p);
        }
    }

    static class ModNumber {
        long val;

        public ModNumber(long v) {
            v %= MODULUS;
            if (v < 0) v += MODULUS;
            this.val = v;
        }

        static int extended_gcd(int a, int m, int[] xy) {
            if (m == 0) {
                xy[0] = 1; xy[1] = 0;
                return a;
            }
            int[] yx = new int[2];
            int g = extended_gcd(m, (int)(a % m), yx);
            xy[1] = yx[0] - (int)(a / m) * yx[1];
            xy[0] = yx[1];
            return g;
        }

        static int inv(int a) {
            int[] xy = new int[2];
            extended_gcd(a, (int)MODULUS, xy);
            int x = xy[0];
            return (x % (int)MODULUS + (int)MODULUS) % (int)MODULUS;
        }

        public static ModNumber operator+(ModNumber a, ModNumber b) {
            return new ModNumber(a.val + b.val);
        }

        public static ModNumber operator-(ModNumber a, ModNumber b) {
            return new ModNumber(a.val - b.val);
        }

        public static ModNumber operator*(ModNumber a, ModNumber b) {
            return new ModNumber(a.val * b.val);
        }

        public static ModNumber operator/(ModNumber a, ModNumber b) {
            return a * new ModNumber(inv((int)b.val));
        }

        public ModNumber pow(long p) {
            if (p < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative exponent");
            ModNumber res = new ModNumber(1);
            ModNumber base = new ModNumber(this.val);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) res = res * base;
                base = base * base;
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        ModNumber[][] prob = new ModNumber[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = new ModNumber(p).divide(new ModNumber(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> count_masks = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int c = 0; c <= N; c++) {
            count_masks.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] index_lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(index_lookup, -1);
        for (int msk = 0; msk < (1 << N); msk++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(msk);
            index_lookup[msk] = count_masks.get(c).size();
            count_masks.get(c).add(msk);
        }

        Map<Long, ModNumber> state_map = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << index_lookup[0];
        state_map.put(initial_mask, new ModNumber(1));

        for (int left_idx = 0; left_idx < N; left_idx++) {
            Map<Long, ModNumber> new_state_map = new HashMap<>();
            ModNumber[] prod_mask = new ModNumber[1 << N];
            for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
                ModNumber prod = new ModNumber(1);
                for (int col = 0; col < N; col++) {
                    if (((mask >> col) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod * prob[left_idx][col];
                    } else {
                        prod = prod * (new ModNumber(1) - prob[left_idx][col]);
                    }
                }
                prod_mask[mask] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits = new long[N];
            ModNumber[] new_possible = new ModNumber[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible, new ModNumber(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
                long mask_state = entry.getKey();
                ModNumber prob_state = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits, 0);
                for (int m : count_masks.get(left_idx)) {
                    if (((mask_state >> index_lookup[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long new_mask = (long)index_lookup[m | (1 << i)];
                                new_bits[i] |= 1L << new_mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible, new ModNumber(0));
                for (int current_mask = 1; current_mask < (1 << N); current_mask++) {
                    int ctz = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current_mask);
                    new_possible[current_mask] = new_possible[current_mask & (current_mask - 1)] | new ModNumber(new_bits[ctz]);
                    long combined_mask = new_possible[current_mask].toLong();
                    long key = combined_mask;
                    ModNumber val = prob_state * prod_mask[current_mask];
                    new_state_map.put(key, new_state_map.getOrDefault(key, new ModNumber(0)) + val);
                }
            }
            state_map = new_state_map;
        }

        ModNumber total = new ModNumber(0);
        int last_mask_index = index_lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModNumber> entry : state_map.entrySet()) {
            long key = entry.getKey();
            if (((key >> last_mask_index) & 1) == 1) {
                total = total + entry.getValue();
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total.val);
    }
}
